# Bundled map extractor

`src-tauri/resources/pmtiles-linux-x86_64` is the Linux x86-64 `pmtiles` binary from the official go-pmtiles 1.31.2 release, commit `a3e4951ea6a0477b784c27c1dcbfd9c130878c5` as reported by the binary (check upstream release metadata when rebuilding). Its SHA-256 is `a7e9ae10184d109c83f456ccdf6df4f3e2a64ba6cf69d9ed0f9f1840305055c1`. License: BSD-3-Clause; see LICENSE. The pinned [fetch script](../../scripts/fetch-pmtiles-linux.sh) downloads and verifies the official binary. Source and releases: https://github.com/protomaps/go-pmtiles.
